sections.heading: Cover Letter
sections.body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm writing to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer role. At Acme Corp, I led a team of eight engineers and redesigned our on-call rotation, cutting incident response time in half. I believe that same focus on ownership would serve your team well.

Sincerely,
Jamie Rivera

sections.heading: Email version
sections.body: Hi -- I'm applying for the Senior Backend Engineer role. At Acme Corp I led a team of eight and cut incident response time in half by redesigning on-call ownership. Happy to share more detail whenever works for you.
